verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS finance product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The per-tool allow/ask/deny policy, the changelog, and OAuth sign-in are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
